newsitem.title: USA: DEC names Claflin world sales/marketing vp.
newsitem.headline: DEC names Claflin world sales/marketing vp.

text.p: Digital Equipment Corp said Wednesday it had named Bruce Claflin as vice president and general manager of worldwide sales and marketing as it consolidates operations.
The company said it was consolidating the sales and marketing operations of its personal computer business and systems business units into a single organization.
The move is designed to help the company focus on customer needs, it said.
The changes "are designed to strengthen support for our current model of direct and indirect sales and will be implemented in a way to avoid disruption at the customer level," the company said.
Claflin had been vice president and general manager of the company's personal computer business unit.
DEC also said it had created a digital products division, which will place its product-related activities into one organization.
"The new organization will be effective July 1," it said. "No restructuring charge or major staff reductions are expected to result from these changes."
